captureContract.audioCaptureMode: Windows Audio Session API (WASAPI) loopback capture from the default render endpoint via direct bun:ffi COM vtable dispatch (CoInitializeEx + CoCreateInstance through ole32.dll → IMMDeviceEnumerator::GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(render, console) → IMMDevice::Activate(IAudioClient) → IAudioClient::Initialize(SHAREMODE_SHARED | STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK) → IAudioClient::GetService(IAudioCaptureClient) → drain via GetNextPacketSize/GetBuffer/ReleaseBuffer until the longest hash window completes).
captureContract.inputInjection: PostMessageW(WM_KEYDOWN, vkCode, 0x00000001) + PostMessageW(WM_KEYUP, vkCode, 0xc0000001) to the PID-filtered Chocolate Doom window handle; SetForegroundWindow is called before each key burst so SDL 1.2's message pump processes the synthesized events.
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-audio-windows.test.ts unconditionally pins the static surface (runner + buildGuidBuffer + AUDIO_HASH_WINDOW_KINDS frozen 2-element list + SFX_HASH_WINDOWS frozen 4-element list + MUSIC_EVENT_HASH_WINDOWS frozen 3-element list + REFERENCE_AUDIO_HASH_WINDOWS frozen 7-element concat + fixture range alignment + override key set + error class shape) and gates the live WASAPI capture on every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present; when gated in, the live test spawns a fresh sandboxed DOOM.EXE, navigates Main → Episode → Skill → E1M1, captures the WASAPI loopback PCM stream through the longest end tic, slices and hashes each of the 7 fixture-aligned windows, and asserts the full evidence record.
